title: Antisthenes
html_source: Antisthenes of Athens (c. 445-365 BCE) was a Greek philosopher who founded the Cynic School. He was a follower of Socrates and appears in Plato’s Phaedo as one of those present at Socrates’ death. In his youth he studied rhetoric under Gorgias.
